manifest_description.message: one panel for twitch, kick + youtube live chat. plus a free 5,000-slot emote inventory that follows you into any channel

popup_errors_title.message: left-click: copy last 50 errors / right-click: clear

btn_auth_save_emotes.message: to use your emotes in every chat

btn_login_save_emotes.message: log in to use your emotes in every chat

content_toast_no_chat_input.message: open twitch chat to use mod actions

mc_connecting.description: empty-tab state while a channel's chat legs are still joining

mc_invalid_name.message: invalid channel name — check for typos or spaces

mc_settings_partial_links_desc.message: also linkify partial and defanged links — bare watch?v= youtube refs and "site (dot) com" style domains chats use to dodge link filters.

mc_settings_media_embeds_desc.message: show images, gifs, video and link cards inline in chat (no autoplaying iframes)

mc_settings_input_preview_desc.message: emote images in input as you type

mc_settings_notif_op_desc.message: ping when a new post hits the feed

mc_settings_notif_op_reply_desc.message: ping when OP replies in their thread

mc_settings_notif_re_desc.message: ping on every reply in any thread

mc_settings_raids_desc.message: banner on raid in/out with viewer count

mc_settings_gift_subs_desc.message: banner for gift subs with gifter and tier

mc_settings_prediction_banner_desc.message: live prediction banner with odds and timer

mc_settings_yt_superchat_desc.message: banner for youtube super chats with amount

mc_settings_yt_supersticker_desc.message: banner for youtube super stickers with amount

mc_settings_yt_membership_desc.message: banner when someone joins as a channel member

mc_settings_yt_gift_memberships_desc.message: banner for gifted memberships with count

mc_settings_first_chatter_desc.message: yellow edge on someone's first message this session

mc_settings_keyword_highlights_desc.message: tints matched messages orange. one per line, case-insensitive, whole-word

mc_social_thread_unavailable.message: thread unavailable — post may have been removed

mc_social_failed_feed_auth.message: failed to load feed — log in at heatsync.org

mc_whisper_login.message: log in to heatsync.org to send whispers

mc_irc_queue_full.message: send queue full — message not saved

mc_input_mentions_readonly.message: mentions — switch to a channel tab to send

mc_input_no_channel.message: no channel — pick a tab above

mc_whisper_follow_to_dm.message: follow $USER$ to dm them — follow + send

mc_irc_join_failed.message: couldn't join $CHANNEL$ — reopen the tab to retry

mc_emote_cold_start_sub.message: pull every 7tv, bttv & ffz emote from $CHANNEL$ into your inventory — one click, renders in every chat.

mc_settings_font_size_desc.message: chat font size in px — drag to taste (replaces the old F-/F+ buttons)

mc_settings_emoji_size_desc.message: emoji size — 1x native, 2x (default)/4x scale unicode emoji

mc_settings_timestamp_format_desc.message: clock format for chat row timestamps

mc_settings_readable_names_desc.message: brighten dim username colors so they're readable on the black bg

mc_settings_platform_badges_desc.message: [T] [K] [Y] labels on messages. off keeps them for the platforms you are not on.

mc_settings_text_badges_desc.message: render mod/vip/sub badges as terse text chips instead of images

mc_settings_tab_position_desc.message: which edge the multichat tab bar docks to

mc_settings_chat_position_desc.message: which side of the player the chat panel docks to — hidden tucks it away (\ key toggles)

mc_settings_yt_suggestions_desc.message: show suggested videos in a vertical strip beside the title (youtube, left/right dock only) — off by default since the chat reclaims that space

mc_settings_yt_chat_non_live_desc.message: show the multichat panel on youtube VODs, home and search too — off by default, so the panel only appears on livestreams (where there is live chat)

mc_settings_message_density_desc.message: row padding — compact is the classic tight look

mc_settings_line_height_desc.message: chat row line height in px — 18 keeps bitmap fonts on the pixel grid

mc_settings_max_visible_messages_desc.message: max chat rows kept as live DOM (data buffer stays 1500). lower = less ram on busy channels.

mc_settings_name_paints_desc.message: animated name paints from heatsync — takes precedence over a 7tv paint when a chatter has both

mc_settings_seventv_paints_desc.message: name paints and 7tv badges on chatters

mc_settings_animate_emotes_desc.message: always plays animated emotes. hover shows static frames until the pointer is on a message — big cpu/ram saver on busy channels. never is fully static. multichat messages; picker stays animated.

mc_settings_animate_paints_desc.message: always plays the motion in name paints — yours and everyone else's. never freezes them flat. this follows the setting, not your browser's reduced-motion flag.

mc_settings_emote_provider_priority_desc.message: when 7tv/bttv/ffz have an emote with the same name, this provider wins

mc_settings_render_inventory_emotes_desc.message: draw emotes that come from a heatsync inventory — yours or another chatter's. off shows the plain word instead. channel and global emotes are unaffected

mc_settings_suggest_inventory_emotes_des.message: offer your inventory in tab-complete and typing suggestions. off leaves only channel and global emotes

mc_settings_show_pronouns_desc.message: pronoundb.org pronouns on the profile card + hover tooltip (twitch only)

mc_settings_anon_chat_desc.message: don't broadcast typing/presence signals to the platform

mc_settings_whisper_toast_desc.message: popup toast when a whisper or dm arrives while you are on another tab — click it to jump to whispers

mc_settings_notif_moment_desc.message: a channel's chat suddenly explodes — heat spike detected server-side; click the row to open the stream

mc_settings_evt_online_desc.message: banner when a channel goes live

mc_settings_evt_offline_desc.message: banner when a channel goes offline (off by default — noisy)

mc_settings_evt_game_switch_desc.message: banner when a streamer changes the game

mc_settings_browser_notification_desc.message: show a desktop notification when someone @s you

mc_settings_tab_title_flash_desc.message: pulse the browser tab title with the mentioner's name until you focus the tab

mc_settings_mention_volume_desc.message: audio ping volume on mention. 0 = silent. uses pure WebAudio tones, no asset shipped.

mc_settings_cross_follow_kick_desc.message: when you follow on heatsync, also follow on kick if they have a linked kick account. needs a kick.com login; queues otherwise

mc_settings_cross_follow_twitch_desc.message: when you follow on heatsync, also follow on twitch if they have a linked twitch account. needs an open twitch.tv tab; queues otherwise

mc_settings_cross_follow_twitch_notify_d.message: cross-platform twitch follows also turn on live notifications for that channel

mc_settings_mod_toolbar_buttons_desc.message: hover actions on chat rows when you mod the channel — all off by default

mc_settings_confirm_ban_desc.message: show a confirm dialog before a permanent ban — guards against a misclick

mc_settings_ban_reasons_desc.message: one per line — shown as selectable chips in the ban dialog; the choice is sent with the ban

mc_settings_automod_caps_desc.message: hide messages over 10 chars that are mostly uppercase

mc_settings_automod_regex_desc.message: one pattern per line, case-insensitive — matching messages get hidden

mc_settings_show_sexual_desc.message: emotes flagged for sexual content (≥ 70%) are hidden by default. shown with a dashed border when on.

mc_settings_show_gore_desc.message: emotes flagged for violence/gore (≥ 70%) are hidden by default. shown with a dashed border when on.

mc_settings_show_weapon_desc.message: emotes flagged for weapons imagery. on by default.

mc_settings_show_drug_desc.message: emotes flagged for drug imagery. on by default.

mc_settings_show_hate_desc.message: emotes flagged for hate imagery. on by default.

mc_settings_hide_bots_desc.message: hide messages from known chat bots (nightbot, streamelements, fossabot…)

mc_settings_hide_duplicates_desc.message: collapse identical consecutive messages (spam waves) to the first one

mc_settings_mute_keywords_desc.message: one term per line — messages containing any get hidden. distinct from keyword highlights.

mc_settings_filter_rules_desc.message: per-rule highlight/hide filters — keyword, regex, user, badge, or msgtype; managed via the rules editor

mc_settings_scroll_wheel_volume_desc.message: scroll over the player to adjust volume

mc_settings_hide_stream_title_desc.message: hide the stream title block under the player

mc_settings_ui_locale_desc.message: multichat ui language — relabels fully on reload

mc_settings_sub_irc_twitch_desc.message: twitch irc connection + channel joins inside the overlay

mc_settings_sub_chat_kick_desc.message: kick websocket connection + channel joins inside the overlay

mc_settings_sub_chat_youtube_desc.message: youtube live chat subscriptions inside the overlay

mc_settings_sub_cosmetics_desc.message: 7tv paints + bttv/ffz/chatterino badges. off saves ram on busy channels.

mc_settings_sub_feed_desc.message: heatsync social feed tab + its event stream

mc_settings_sub_whispers_desc.message: twitch whisper eventsub socket + whispers tab

mc_settings_sub_mentions_desc.message: mention detection, mentions tab and pings

mc_settings_sub_stream_stats_desc.message: per-channel message-rate stats powering heat ranking

mc_settings_sub_profile_cards_desc.message: click a username for the profile card popup

mc_settings_sub_emote_render_desc.message: render heatsync emotes inside the platform’s own chat

mc_settings_sub_tab_complete_desc.message: emote + username completion in the platform’s own input

mc_settings_sub_picker_button_desc.message: the heatsync picker button beside the native chat input

mc_settings_sub_native_takeover_desc.message: while the overlay covers twitch chat, stop twitch rendering its hidden copy — big ram save on busy channels. fails open: overlay dies → twitch chat comes back on its own.

mc_settings_sub_kick_native_tap_desc.message: reads the current kick page's own chat stream as a backup. inert while the normal transports are healthy — only kicks in if they go quiet.

mc_settings_sub_yt_innertube_tap_desc.message: polls youtube directly if both normal feeds go silent for 5 minutes — a last-resort backstop, not a replacement transport.

mc_settings_sub_automod_queue_desc.message: shows twitch automod holds inline in channels you mod, with allow/deny buttons — mirrors twitch's own review queue.

mc_automod_relink_toast.message: automod queue needs a twitch relink

mc_settings_diag_errors_desc.message: errors are captured locally only — never uploaded. this toggle just shows the diagnostic panel below.

mc_settings_debug_logging_desc.message: verbose console logging from all heatsync scripts — applies on next page load

mc_crossfollow_2fa_follow.message: twitch follow blocked: 2FA required — complete on twitch.tv

mc_crossfollow_2fa_unfollow.message: twitch unfollow blocked: 2FA required — complete on twitch.tv

mc_crossfollow_kick_queued_follow.message: kick follow queued — will sync when you log in to kick.com

mc_crossfollow_kick_queued_unfollow.message: kick unfollow queued — will sync when you log in to kick.com

mc_crossfollow_twitch_queued_follow.message: twitch follow queued — will sync next time you open twitch.tv

mc_crossfollow_twitch_queued_unfollow.message: twitch unfollow queued — will sync next time you open twitch.tv

mc_emote_add_login.message: log in to heatsync.org to add emotes

mc_emote_block_sync_failed.message: block not saved to your account — will differ on other devices

mc_emote_unblock_sync_failed.message: unblock not saved to your account — will differ on other devices

mc_input_delete_needs_platform_channel.message: /delete needs a twitch or kick channel

mc_input_followers_twitch_only.message: /followers is twitch-only — open a twitch channel

mc_input_login_first_op.message: log in at heatsync.org first to /op

mc_input_mod_needs_platform_channel.message: /$CMD$ needs a twitch, kick, or youtube channel

mc_input_yt_mod_no_recent_msg.message: youtube: no recent message from $TARGET$ — use the message menu

mc_input_mode_not_wired.message: /$CMD$ isn't wired yet — only /followers works for now

mc_input_nuke_needs_platform_channel.message: /nuke needs a twitch or kick channel

mc_input_nuke_no_matches.message: /nuke: no messages matching "$TERM$" in the last $SEC$s

mc_input_rate_limited.message: rate limited — try in a sec

mc_input_pp_needs_twitch.message: this needs a twitch channel tab

mc_input_usage_poll.message: /poll question | choice1 | choice2 [| … up to 5] [| secs]

mc_input_usage_prediction.message: /prediction title | outcome1 | outcome2 [| … up to 10] [| secs]

mc_input_set_complex.message: change that one in the settings panel

mc_input_mode_twitch_unsupported.message: twitch has no api for $LABEL$ — kick only

mc_input_cmd_twitch_removed.message: twitch removed /$CMD$ from chat — use its own mod tools

mc_input_highlight_unconfirmed.message: highlight didn’t confirm — resend is safe, bits charge once

mc_irc_notice_banned.message: you are banned from this channel

mc_irc_notice_emoteonly.message: emote-only mode — message must be all emotes

mc_irc_notice_followersonly.message: followers-only mode — follow the channel to chat

mc_irc_notice_followersonly_followed.message: follow the channel a bit longer to chat

mc_irc_notice_followersonly_zero.message: followers-only — you need to follow first

mc_irc_notice_no_permission.message: no permission to do that here

mc_irc_notice_r9k.message: unique-chat mode — message must be unique

mc_irc_notice_slowmode.message: slow mode — please wait a moment

mc_irc_notice_unrecognized_cmd.message: twitch did not recognize that command

mc_irc_notice_verified_email.message: channel requires a verified email to chat

mc_irc_notice_verified_phone.message: channel requires a verified phone to chat

mc_main_age_confirm.message: confirm you are 18+ to enable adult content

mc_main_celebration_share_failed.message: celebration share failed — sending your message to chat

mc_main_message_not_sent.message: message could not be sent — it is still shown in your celebration row

mc_main_mute_save_failed.message: mute list not saved — storage error

mc_main_no_share_token.message: no share token — celebration sent without text, your message goes to chat

mc_main_no_yt_stream.message: no live youtube stream to pop out

mc_main_quota_near_limit.message: settings storage near limit — some preferences may not save across devices

mc_main_settings_save_failed.message: settings failed to save — storage quota exceeded

mc_main_share_unavailable.message: share unavailable — sending your message to chat

mc_notifs_share_token_missing.message: share token missing — use twitch's own chat to share

mc_profile_cross_sync_unavailable.message: followed on heatsync — cross-platform sync unavailable

mc_settingsui_presets_storage_full.message: presets storage full — delete one first

mc_settingsui_rules_corrupted.message: filter rules corrupted — editing disabled until reload

mc_settingsui_rules_corrupted_reload.message: filter rules corrupted — reload the page before editing

mc_twitchapi_popup_blocked.message: popup blocked — allow popups for twitch.tv to cheer

mc_whisper_not_enabled.message: twitch whispers not enabled — re-link on heatsync.org

mc_yt_send_bridge_timeout.message: couldn’t reach youtube chat — try again

mc_yt_send_loading.message: youtube chat still loading — try again

mc_yt_mod_action_unmapped.message: youtube has no such action for that message

mc_yt_mod_message_not_found.message: that message is no longer on screen

mc_yt_mod_no_context_menu.message: youtube didn’t offer mod actions on that message

mc_yt_mod_not_moderator.message: you’re not a moderator of this stream

mc_yt_send_open_stream.message: open the youtube stream to send

mc_yt_send_restricted.message: yt chat is restricted for this stream

mc_msg_start_thread.message: start a thread from this message
mc_msg_start_thread.description: Tooltip on the per-message button that seeds a new heatsync thread with a quote of that chat message
